info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Order Management API
info.description: The Market Order Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently handle market orders within wholesale trading. This API facilitates the submission and processing of various types of market orders, ensuring timely execution and compliance with trading regulations. It caters to banks, trading firms, and financial analysts who require real-time order management capabilities. By utilizing this API, users can streamline their trading workflow and enhance their operational efficiency in the competitive banking sector.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to place a new market order for wholesale trading. You can specify the order details in the request body, including the item, quantity, and any additional options required for the order. Make sure to validate the inputs before submission to ensure a smooth transaction.

requestBody.description: Contains the details required to place a market order in the wholesale trading system. Ensure that all necessary fields are included and correctly formatted to ensure a successful transaction.

201.description: The market order has been successfully created.
